column1: # gimpel -- programs the ORACLE cannot grade. A RULING about sbl -bf and about what this
# package ships, never about us: an entry here is disputable, and nobody owes work on it.
# Authored hq_P 2026-09-06 from a measured run of the oracle over every entry, one at a time.

column3: a library module, not a program: a DEFINE plus its body and a :(NAME_END) label, with no main program and no END statement (the package's own README.md states the two kinds). sbl -bf exits 1 with zero output on 134 of the 145; the other 11 exit 0 while printing a fatal report or nothing at all, so the oracle yields no program output to grade against for any of them.
